scene.name: C0_CORRIDOR
scene.origin: Existing C0 input geometry, not a new independently simulated environment

channel.pole_model: P1 source-only Cartesian polynomial cap, not solver truth

pilot.source: Original Tnone timeline CSV route keys, no new sampled or inferred timestamp
pilot.selection_algorithm: For each sorted route original timeline, take 0,1,floor(n/8),floor(n/4),floor(n/2),floor(3n/4),floor(7n/8),n-2,n-1 plus distinct nearest XY to each of original anchors A,B and proposed C plus maximum abs(y); sorted unique pose IDs
pilot.reference_mode: original A/B NativeLoS only: same XY/timeline/mount0; C absent and labeled SOURCE_ONLY_PILOT
pilot.sample_usage: ground-truth pose used for offline physical source-only canary input; never as filter input

controls.direct_field_independent_oracle: research/FFD_P0P3_20261016/p0_initial.py:direct with original bank, compare SourceFFD for off-pole only

resource_policy.pilot_packets_source_only: 3 anchors per unique route pilot pose; 2 RX ports, 1 TX, 257 bins each
resource_policy.proposal_for_future_p4: 3 separate anchor TX acquisitions/observation sets per common epoch; 3x vs single-anchor per-time RF resource; not equal resource
